reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. The reply confirms that the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Dock 23 and that nothing else is needed. I took no other action.

I didn't save this to my persistent memory. That memory carries into every conversation, including ones with members who aren't in #central-team. The message stays in the channel, where the team can still see it.
